ExamRuleFinder() { const [query, setQuery] = useState('') const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState('All') const filteredExams = useMemo(() => { return EXAM_DATABASE.filter((exam) => { const matchesCategory = activeCategory === 'All' || exam.category === activeCategory const matchesQuery = exam.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) || exam.fullName.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) || exam.category.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) return matchesCategory && matchesQuery }) }, [query, activeCategory]) return (
